user.title: Zero Grid Controller — Grid Sensors
user.description: Add the sensors that measure how much power is drawn from and delivered to the grid. Add PV arrays and batteries as subentries after setup.

data.name: Integration name
data.grid_import_sensors: Grid import sensors (power drawn from grid)
data.grid_export_sensors: Grid export sensors (power delivered to grid, optional)
data.invert_sign: Invert sign (if your import sensor shows negative values for import)

mode_guard.title: Optimizer integration (optional)
mode_guard.description: Connect to an optimizer like Battery Controller to coordinate control modes. When enabled, an external entity drives whether Zero Grid Controller runs actively, passively, or is disabled.

mode_mapping.title: Map optimizer modes
mode_mapping.description: For each mode value of the selected entity, choose what Zero Grid Controller should do.

done.title: Setup complete
done.description: Zero Grid Controller is ready. Add PV arrays and batteries as subentries. The controller will start learning your system automatically.

abort.already_configured: Zero Grid Controller is already configured.

user.title: Add PV array
user.description: Configure the PV inverter output you want the controller to manage.

data.setpoint_entity: Entity that sets the power limit
data.pv_power_entity: PV power sensor (optional, improves cloud detection)
data.inverter_speed: How fast does this inverter respond?

reconfigure.title: Configure PV array
reconfigure.description: Update the settings for this PV array.

data.setpoint_entity: Entity that sets the power limit
data.inverter_speed: How fast does this inverter respond?

user.title: Add battery
user.description: Configure a battery storage system for the controller to monitor and optionally control.

data.name: Battery name (e.g. Home Battery)
data.battery_control_enabled: Allow Zero Grid Controller to control battery setpoint

reconfigure.title: Configure battery
reconfigure.description: Update the settings for this battery.

data.name: Battery name
data.battery_control_enabled: Allow Zero Grid Controller to control battery setpoint

init.title: Zero Grid Controller options
init.description: Enable expert mode to manually tune PID and estimator parameters. The online auto-tuner is disabled when expert mode is active.

grid_sensor_unavailable.title: Grid sensor unavailable
grid_sensor_unavailable.description: One or more grid import sensors are unavailable. Zero Grid Controller cannot function without a valid grid measurement. Check that the sensors are configured correctly and the integrations providing them are running.

reset_pid.name: Reset PID
reset_pid.description: Reset the PID integrator and derivative history.

recalibrate.name: Recalibrate
recalibrate.description: Re-run automatic step-response calibration for one or all arrays.

array_name.name: Array name
array_name.description: Name of the array to calibrate. Leave empty to calibrate all arrays.

override_setpoint.name: Override setpoint
override_setpoint.description: Force a setpoint for an array, bypassing PID for up to 5 minutes.

array_name.name: Array name
array_name.description: Name of the array to override.

value.name: Value
value.description: Setpoint value (% or W, matching the array's output type).
